title: Judgment-skill I/O: excerpt files, passages, passages_checked
description: Three file shapes discriminated by 'kind'. (1) Excerpt files audit/excerpts/<skill>.json are each judgment specialist's single prepared input - one read, one judgment, one write, <=3 tool calls (SECOND_REVIEW 2.5); excerpts are bounded (<=1,500 chars per candidate location), never whole pages. (2) audit/passages.json is answerability's output mapping generated questions to candidate answer passages. (3) audit/passages_checked.json is collect_snapshot.py --passages output: deterministic text-node contiguity per candidate passage (text-fragment landing survivability), read by referral-experience. NOTE for build_report.py's vendored validator: this schema uses oneOf and is dev-oracle-only; the runtime-validated schemas (output, fragment, snapshot) do not.

budget_chars.description: total excerpt budget for this skill's input file

extras.description: per-skill additions: referral-experience <- probes subset (soft_404, redirect_path_preservation) plus the passages_checked results; freshness-consistency <- sitemap lastmod summary + claim_index across pages; answerability <- nothing extra

id.description: stable heading ids matter for the referral fragment/anchor checks

main_content_excerpts.description: candidate answer locations only - never the whole page

char_offset.description: offset into the page's visible_text, for evidence citation

claim_index_subset.description: claims from this page relevant to the target skill

expected_page.description: the page that should answer this question

qualifier_present.description: does the passage carry its own qualifications/exceptions?

source_location.description: heading path / char offset for evidence

contiguous.description: candidate_passage exists as one contiguous visible text-node run in the page's raw HTML

note.description: e.g. 'price split across three spans', 'inside collapsed details'
